title: Text: DET Greg Garno ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: I hope you have a shitty day

I had to wake up at 3:30 to drive my parents to the airport by 5:00, sat in a Denny’s alone for an hour and a half, get stitches removed from my mouth then at 8:00 AM, then two shots of anesthetic and a new crown put on a tooth paid for without dental insurance today. So you’ll be happy to know today has been miserable lol
It is less than ideal lol
I can’t deal with shots in the mouth
And I sit here putting cancer in my mouth everyday
It’s hurting pretty good right now. I’m gonna go get some Ibuprofen and hopefully that will help settle everything down.
